description: Big weapons, short tempers - crits that pay for themselves and a finisher for anything wounded.
_source_note: Rebuilt 6 Nov 2026 from the 38 real CoA Brutality talents (role DPS). Energy is the whole pool on both sides - no second currency to translate, unlike Felsworn or Ranger - so every cost and refund talent lands. execute_threshold_pct 35 was added to barbarian_decapitate to match CoA and give this tree's execute theme something to key off; Brutality owns the class's low_health_threshold_pct at the same 0.35. Four talents die on 'above 80% health', which has no conditional at all.

nodes.name: Pure Power
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Smash by 30% and your expertise by 10.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Smash by 15% and your expertise by 5.' PORTS EXACTLY, doubled - and the second half would have been dead a day earlier. `expertise` was read by NO engine code for most of this audit, because it reduces a target's dodge and parry and monsters had neither, which cost Guardian's Stalwart and Gladiator's Double Duty their text outright. Kyle had creature avoidance added on 5 Nov 2026 and it became a real stat. It is in PERCENTAGE POINTS and subtracts from dodge AND parry independently; the ability key is a FRACTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Reckless Movements
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Ancestral Strike and Barbaric Whirl by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Ancestral Strike and Barbaric Whirl by 20%.' PORTS VERBATIM, both abilities - one of the few CoA talents in this tree needing no translation at all. Ancestral Strike is the spec's zero-cooldown filler, so three nodes here point at it. Both FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Bloody Fighter
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Brutal Swing and Smash by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Brutal Swing and Smash by 5%.' PORTS EXACTLY, doubled. This tree keys off crits six times (Relentless, Headlopper, Anger Issues, Sustaining Swings, Spiked Weapons, the capstone), so crit chance is its real currency. Per-ability crit keys are PERCENTAGE POINTS, unlike the damage keys above, which are fractions. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Efficient Killer
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of all your abilities by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Energy cost of your spells and abilities by 10%.' PORTS VERBATIM (raised to 15%) - CoA's Energy IS our energy, since Barbarian is (ResourceType.ENERGY, None) with no second currency, which makes this one of the cleanest resource ports in the whole audit. all_ability_cost_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION; it flips to percentage POINTS inside a status effect, which caught me on Ranger Farstrider tonight. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Relentless
nodes.description: Your critical strikes restore 10 Energy.
nodes._source: CoA level 20 passive: 'Critical strikes with Ancestral Strike and Brutal Swing now refund 10 Energy.' PORTS VERBATIM, including the exact amount - only the two-ability scoping goes, since there is no per-ability proc trigger. grant_resource routes through the same gain_resource() the class's three generators use, so the cap is respected, and its `amount` is FLAT: there is no pct_max field, which is why CoA's Thirst for Battle ('regenerate 25% of your maximum Energy') and Beheader ('refunds 100% of your maximum Energy') both become flat numbers too. Inventing a percentage field on Witch Doctor's Spiritual Devotee granted NOTHING while passing every check.

nodes.name: Thirst for Battle
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 25% chance to restore 15 Energy.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Smash now regenerate 25% of your maximum Energy.' The restore ports; the percentage does not, because grant_resource takes a FLAT `amount` with no percentage-of-maximum form. The Smash scoping goes too (no per-ability proc trigger), so it becomes a 25% chance on any swing. Folded in CoA's Beheader ('scoring a kill blow with Decapitate now refunds 100% of your maximum Energy') - on_kill IS a live trigger, but a proc takes one trigger and the swing version fires far more often, so the kill form is dropped rather than given its own node.

nodes.name: Crusher
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 20% chance to reset the cooldown of Crush.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Melee auto attacks now have a 10% chance to reset the cooldown of Crush.' PORTS VERBATIM, doubled for the two ranks. reset_cooldown WITH A BARE LIST is a full reset, as against the {abilities, turns} form which only shaves turns - confusing the two is silent and easy to do. Folded in CoA's Power Swings ('reduces the cooldown of Crush by -5 sec'), which names the same ability. Crush is a 5-turn-cooldown AoE, so this is a real throughput node.

nodes.name: Spiked Weapons
nodes.description: Increases your physical critical damage by 20% and your armor penetration by 100.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical damage of Crush, Brutal Swing, and Decapitate by 20%.' CoA's 20% is kept but widened to a global, because this tree crits six different ways and three per-ability crit-damage keys would be narrower than CoA intends. Folded in CoA's Battering Ram ('while wielding a two-handed weapon, you bypass 10% of enemy armor'), whose weapon-type gate cannot be built - nothing reads weapon type - and whose '10% of armor' has no proportional form, since armor_penetration is FLAT. crit_damage_* keys are FRACTIONS; armor_penetration is a flat rating, which is why they look mismatched here. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Headlopper
nodes.description: Your critical strikes open a bleed dealing damage over 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your critical strikes with Decapitate now cause the enemy to bleed, dealing an additional 30% of the damage dealt over 5 seconds.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY. The Decapitate scoping goes (no per-ability proc trigger) and '30% of the damage dealt' becomes a fixed potency, because apply_effect cannot read the triggering hit's amount - only bonus_pct, leech_pct and smart heals do, and none of them apply an effect. 5 sec -> 3 turns. A proc-applied dot carries `potency` as PER-TURN damage (32 a turn, 96 total) where an ABILITY rank's effect_value is the TOTAL and gets divided (abilities.py:2695).

nodes.name: Horde Breaker
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 35% chance to wound the target, increasing their physical damage taken by 8% for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Crush now applies Wounded to enemies for 1 min and is now guaranteed to critically strike enemies affected by Headbutt. Wounded increases Physical Damage taken by 4% for 1 min.' The Wounded debuff ports at double value over 2 stacks. The guaranteed-crit clause fails twice: nothing grants a guaranteed crit on a specific ability, and 'enemies affected by Headbutt' needs to read a target's debuffs. 1 min -> 4 turns. CAREFUL: physical_damage_taken_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS inside a status effect (monster.py:736 divides by 100) where as a TALENT effect it is a fraction - so 8 is 8%, and 0.08 would have delivered 0.08%.

nodes.name: Anger Issues
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 35% chance to reduce the cooldown of Killing Spree and Unbridled Rage by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Scoring a critical strike against an enemy now reduces the cooldown of Carnage by -4 sec.' Carnage is not in our ability book, so the node is re-pointed at Killing Spree and Unbridled Rage, the spec's two real cooldowns. Folded in CoA's Deep Fury ('direct Physical damage dealt now reduces the cooldown of Unbridled Rage by -1 sec'), which names the same ability. The {abilities, turns} form of reset_cooldown shaves turns rather than resetting outright, which is what CoA describes - a BARE LIST would reset them fully.

nodes.name: Ancestral Trauma
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 25% of your Strength.
nodes._source: CoA level 50 passive: 'Damage dealt by Ancestral Strike and Crush now scales with your Strength.' A per-ability stat SCALING coefficient is not something any key reaches - the ability keys are _damage, _healing, _crit, _crit_damage, _cost, _cooldown, _duration and _potency, and none touch how an ability scales off a stat. Rebuilt as a real global conversion: attack_power is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and strength in SOURCES, a legal pair, so a Barbarian's Strength genuinely becomes attack power and reaches every ability rather than two. Folded in CoA's Body Builder, whose 'when your Strength is lower than your Agility' clause cannot be built: nothing compares two of the caster's own stats. A FRACTION.

nodes.name: Overkill
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Decapitate and Headhunter's Spear by 30%, and your damage against enemies below 35% health by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Decapitate and Headhunter's Spear by 30% against targets below 20% health.' The crit chance ports verbatim at CoA's 30% on both abilities, unconditional - there is no conditional CRIT key, only conditional damage - with the conditional half added as low_health_damage_pct, the key introduced 6 Nov 2026 for the 48 CoA talents across 18 of the 21 classes worded this way. THIS IS THE ONE NODE IN ALL OF BARBARIAN THAT SETS low_health_threshold_pct, at 0.35 to match the execute_threshold_pct added to barbarian_decapitate the same day (CoA: 'Only usable on enemies below 35% health'), so the class's execute window and its execute ability's own gate agree. That key SUMS across talents, is UNSCALED so rank does not divide it, and a character can spend in several trees - Headhunting and Ancestry inherit it, and a second setter would give 70%. Tinker once shipped two summing to 0.8. main() asserts exactly one and tools/qa_summing_thresholds.py enforces it class-wide. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Ogre's Strength
nodes.description: Increases your Strength by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA level 40 passive: 'Increases your Strength by 25%.' PORTS VERBATIM, which for a node this large is worth noting. strength_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS (character.py:1262 divides by 100), so 25 is 25% - and it compounds with Ancestral Trauma one tier below, which converts that Strength into attack power, so the two nodes are deliberately adjacent. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Whirling Assault
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Whirling Advance by 60% and of Barbaric Whirl by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Whirling Advance by 300% on enemies above 80% health.' CoA gates this on the target being ABOVE 80% health. high_health_damage_threshold_pct is DEAD DATA - authored somewhere in this project and read by nothing - and there is no above-health conditional of any kind, only the below-health low_health_damage_pct added 6 Nov 2026. Dropped, with the value kept unconditional and the gain flagged rather than pocketed quietly. CoA's 300% is cut to 60% precisely because it is now unconditional - a 300% unconditional damage increase on an AoE would dwarf everything else in the tree, where CoA's version only applies to opening hits. Extended to Barbaric Whirl, which CoA's Steelslinger also buffs ('increases its damage dealt by 100% on enemies below 35% health') and which fails the same way in the other direction - Overkill already owns the class's below-health threshold, so a second conditional node here would have had to share it. Both FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Killing Spree
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Killing Spree and Berserker Rush by 35%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Charge at an enemy, dealing Physical damage. Can only be used within 6 seconds of scoring a killing blow or applying Born in Blood.' The ability already exists on a 6-turn cooldown. ITS USE WINDOW CANNOT BE BUILT: execute_threshold_pct gates on the TARGET's health, not on whether the caster recently killed something, and there is no on_kill-granted usability state - bypass_execute_threshold is the only consumable gate flag and it goes the other way. Born in Blood is a CoA buff we do not have. So the node boosts both charge abilities instead. Both FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Storm of Steel
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Storm of Steel by 40% and its duration by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Begin striking your target every 0.5 sec for 80% Weapon Damage for 3 sec.' Ours is a 3-turn dot on a 6-turn cooldown, since there is no channelling. BOTH HALVES ARE REAL DAMAGE: +2 turns on a dot ADDS TICKS at full per-turn value, because abilities.py:2777 derives per_turn from the ability's OWN base duration rather than the talented one - so the dot goes 3 -> 5 turns and its total rises by two thirds on top of the 40%. Folded in CoA's Steel Fury, whose per-strike ramp ('increases the damage of its subsequent strikes by 4%, stacking 10 times') needs a readable stack count, and whose +2.5 sec duration this node delivers. SMALL INTEGER IN TURNS, so talent_ranks.spread() refuses to rank this node.

nodes.name: Maximum Carnage
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Unbridled Rage's follow-up by 30% and your area damage by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Unbridled Rage now causes you to begin swinging your weapon around you dealing Physical damage to up to 5 nearby enemies over 5 seconds.' A follow-up AoE that starts when a buff is cast needs a per-ability proc trigger, which does not exist, so the node becomes flat damage on Unbridled Rage plus aoe_damage. aoe_damage is read at abilities.py:1600 ONLY when target_type is enemy_aoe, so it is genuinely scoped to area attacks rather than a stealth global - this spec has five (Whirling Advance, Barbaric Whirl, Brutal Swing, Crush, Keg Smash). Folded in CoA's Utter Devastation, whose consumable guaranteed crit has no mechanism. Both FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Skullseeker
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 8% and your physical damage by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical strike chance against enemies above 80% health by 25%.' CoA gates this on the target being ABOVE 80% health. high_health_damage_threshold_pct is DEAD DATA - authored somewhere in this project and read by nothing - and there is no above-health conditional of any kind, only the below-health low_health_damage_pct added 6 Nov 2026. Dropped, with the value kept unconditional and the gain flagged rather than pocketed quietly. CoA's 25% is cut to 8% precisely because it is now unconditional and permanent where CoA's applies only to opening hits. The physical damage is added so the node is not a bare crit scalar. crit_chance_physical is PERCENTAGE POINTS; physical_damage is a FRACTION - two conventions in one dict, which is this project's default state. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Sustaining Swings
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 25% chance to heal you for 15% of the damage dealt and strike an additional time.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Melee attacks now have an 8% chance to heal you for 10% of the damage dealt and cause your next Ancestral Strike to deal 50% increased damage.' THE LEECH PORTS EXACTLY: leech_pct is one of only THREE proc payloads that READ the triggering hit's amount, so '% of the damage dealt' is literally what it computes - and on_weapon_swing is the right trigger for it, unlike the avoidance triggers where the amount is always zero and it would silently heal nothing. 'Your next Ancestral Strike deals 50% more' cannot be built: nothing marks a specific ability's next cast. Replaced with CoA's own Rancor ('your Brutal Swing now triggers an additional auto attack'), since `extra_attack` is a BOOLEAN giving exactly one extra attack, which is precisely what Rancor asks for. One proc can carry both payloads, which is why the capstone does both halves. 8% -> 25% because it is the capstone.
